items.title: Cross-dimensional Weingarten convolution recursion from virtual isometries for k plus one at most n
items.author: Benoît Collins; Sho Matsumoto
items.source_version: Official SIGMA22(2026),077; publisher final form August10,2026; published August18,2026
items.difficulty_reason: Derives the dimension-changing convolution through the reflection decomposition of Haar unitary matrices, explicit mixed rank-one moments, ascension functions and independence. The complete source-local reflection/moment argument remains in the task, rather than being removed as background. The k+1<=n restriction and authors low-dimensional boundary discussion are preserved; the separate k=n formula is not another counted task.

primary.label: Complete author convolution-recursion statement with k+1<=n

proof_spans.label: Full complex-reflection and mixed-moment proofs, Haar-matrix decomposition, convolution and ascension-function definition
Complete ascension expectation lemma and main recursion proof

contexts.label: Complete author Weingarten and virtual-isometry introduction and setup
Author range restriction and transition to supporting lemma
Remaining full author body, including low-dimensional failure discussion and uncounted k=n formula, acknowledgements
